overall_summary: Data clearly indicates that relationship dynamics, particularly husband-wife and romantic/family bonds with a realistic, slightly painful perspective, dramatically outperform generic sad shayari or motivation.

winning_patterns.evidence: Videos like 'Shaadi Ke Baad Pyaar Kahan Chala Gaya?' (1770 views) and 'पत्नी की ये बात हर पति को समझनी चाहिए' (1679 views) have significantly higher views than other content.
winning_patterns.action: Focus heavily on domestic and adult relationship realities, misunderstandings, and unspoken emotional burdens between partners.

winning_patterns.evidence: Titles framing everyday realizations ('Har Baar Sorry Bolne Wala Galat Nahi Hota', 392 views) perform well compared to abstract shayari ('जिस दिन सच लिखूंगा', 21 views).
winning_patterns.action: Use conversational, experience-based hooks rather than heavy poetic language.

weak_patterns.evidence: 'जिस दिन सच लिखूंगा… रिश्तों को षड्यंत्र लिखूंगा' received only 21 views.
weak_patterns.action: Avoid overly dramatic, poetic, or cryptic phrasing; keep the language grounded and conversational.

weak_patterns.evidence: Early sister videos performed poorly (e.g., 19 views on one iteration), showing less audience appetite for generic family tropes compared to spousal or individual struggle dynamics.
weak_patterns.action: Prioritize spousal relationships and inner emotional solitude over broader family sweetness.
